contingencies.label: Appraisal
contingencies.hint: Buyer can renegotiate or walk if it appraises under the price.

contingencies.label: Inspection
contingencies.hint: Buyer can ask for repairs or walk after the report.

contingencies.label: Financing
contingencies.hint: Buyer can walk if their loan falls through. Cash offers drop this.

contingencies.label: Home sale
contingencies.hint: Buyer has to sell their own place first. The riskiest one to accept.

label.label: Offer
label.hint: Rename it to the buyer or their agent once you know.

purchasePrice.label: Purchase price
purchasePrice.hint: What they are offering, before any concessions.

downPaymentPct.label: Down payment
downPaymentPct.hint: Percent down. Choosing Cash sets this to 100.

financingType.label: Financing
financingType.hint: Cash closes fastest and cannot fall apart over a loan.

closingDate.label: Closing date
closingDate.hint: The date on the contract. The earliest one earns Fastest Close.

contingencies.label: Contingencies kept
contingencies.hint: Tick what the buyer is keeping. Anything unticked is waived.

specialTerms.label: Special terms
specialTerms.placeholder: Escalates to $890k in $5k steps · 14-day seller rent-back
specialTerms.hint: Escalation clauses, rent-backs, appliances — anything unusual.

agentNotes.label: Agent notes
agentNotes.placeholder: Local lender, responsive. Buyer has walked it twice.
agentNotes.hint: Your read on the offer. Hidden in Seller Presentation view.
